t: What Battery Chemistry Database Is All About
title: What Battery Chemistry Database Is All About
description: Batteries trade energy, power, life, cost, and safety: lithium-ion NMC packs ~250 Wh/kg for EVs; LFP gives ~160 Wh/kg but 3,000+ cycles and better thermal stability; lead-acid manages 35 Wh/kg but starts every car cheaply. Degradation is chemistry: SEI layer growth consumes lithium, and heat accelerates everything. Recycling recovers cobalt, nickel, and lithium — the metals worth chasing. This database is the complete battery chemistry: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

key_points: energy density: Wh per kg or liter
C-rate: charge/discharge speed relative to capacity
SEI: solid-electrolyte interphase layer
cycle life: full cycles before capacity fades
BMS: battery management system
thermal runaway: self-accelerating overheating
